[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/bcf9b66e5b533dc5b20add7d8537f80de48590bb.png"]

Supercar Collection Simulator 1.0 is now fully released after early access!

Do you remember the excitement of discovering your first supercar?

Black Market – Full of Secrets 🚐
The Black Market will appear in the city at certain times. Play a mini guessing game to negotiate the price of rare collectible cars and grab these special cars before the opportunity vanishes.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/3f8a3926f983cb02585fefac2211a50dde5f94ca.gif"]

Add new cars to your collection. Expand your shelves and join races to hunt down the next "must-have" model.

Buy rare collector cars, play a mini guessing game to negotiate the price, and grab exclusive deals before the van disappears.

Expand your shelves and hunt down the next must have models for your collection.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/aa766d82f0ba140f4c721fe4fe7966693cfa9b9b.gif"]

notes.title: REGULAR UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello dear players,

Update Notes:

Bugs in the painting system have been fixed.

Issues with texture import and export have been resolved.

The sticker import limit has been increased from 2 MB to 4 MB.

A special button has been added to use the painted vehicle’s image as a sticker (available in the Special Sticker menu). This way, you can use the image of your custom-designed car in car packages.

The Supercar logo can now be used as a sticker.

The limit for custom addable stickers has been increased from 20 to 100.

A button has been added to rename vehicles. Now you can give any name you like to your custom cars.

Open storage boxes will now automatically close when placed on a shelf.

Store statistics application

Profitability mechanics based on store rating

"Hunt House" game is now classified as a daytime activity

Extra series probabilities have been adjusted

The paint and bundle table can now be placed in the storage room.

Item storage boxes can no longer be placed on the storage shelves. These shelves are now exclusively for product storage boxes.

The game will very soon be available in its 1.0 version.
In the full release, all car series and the BlackMarket vendor will be waiting for you!



have fun!









[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/8b03f673c87fe7fac4712c42abc5955e4eab63b5.png"]-SIERRA

notes.title: PAINTABLE CARS
notes.content:

Here come the paintable cars – find them, customize them, and own them!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/ab52024d477dc2f985c6d7b5fbc3fd0dec4d71b2.gif"]



You can collect a total of 8 customizable cars from the Faster, Pro, Elite, and Champ boxes.
Once acquired, head over to the Design Table and personalize both the car and the package with:
• Paint jobs
• Sticker uploads

You can even share your designs with friends so they can use the same style!

Note: We encountered some structural issues when trying to allow modification of the cars’ performance features and add-ons, so those options could not be included in the car design process.

This update also includes several performance optimizations.

In the upcoming update, HuntHouse will operate based on the in-game time cycle.

notes.title: STORE AND STORAGE WORKERS
notes.content:
Hello dear players!
Here comes the brand-new Store and Storage Workers!

Now, your ordered items will be carried to the warehouse and placed on the shelves by workers—so you can focus more on building your collection!

🔧 Update Notes:
Added 4 Store Workers

Added 4 Storage Workers

Warehouse is now available

Warehouse shelves can be purchased
The warehouse shelves can only be used for product boxes.

After reaching level 30, you can automatically open all your boxes by simply pressing the T key!

As we approach the full release, there are just a few updates and bug fixes left.
However, we still haven’t been able to consistently reproduce the Skill Card usability bug.
If any player can consistently trigger this bug, please let us know in which situations it occurs. Your help is highly appreciated!

The delay in this update was due to our decision to release both Store and Storage Workers together.
Instead of splitting them into separate updates, we wanted to deliver them as one complete package.
Thank you for your patience and support! ❤️


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/ddc9e62900d828b45f739e49b0d12422d936b4c3.gif

have fun!

notes.title: REGULAR UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello dear players,
I'm here with a regular update before the next big patch!

I noticed many of you were unhappy with the vending machine area and its pricing. This update includes some adjustments to address that.

Here are the update notes:

3 new challenging and luck-based achievements have been added.

Vending machine probabilities have been rebalanced, and the vending machine price has been updated to $25.

Twitch integration has been added to the game.

A bug where shield and rocket skills caused slowdown effects during NPC races has been fixed.

There was also an issue where cars wouldn't be awarded at the end of races. We made some adjustments to address this, but honestly, we're not entirely sure if the issue is completely resolved, as we haven't been able to reproduce it.
Please let us know if you still encounter this problem.

And finally, a small hint for the future:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/c327d77617a1e259f2ddd622ff1eb2f964701967.png


have fun!








{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/8b03f673c87fe7fac4712c42abc5955e4eab63b5.png-SIERRA

notes.title: BUG FIX
notes.content:
Hello dear players,
Before our next major update, we're releasing a small bug fix patch.
Here are the patch notes:

Fixed an issue where skills behaved incorrectly in NPC races.

Resolved a bug where skill cards were dropping from the wrong packs (Series 1 cards were appearing in Series 2 packs).

Fixed an outline issue on Race Track 02.

Skills no longer travel endlessly until they hit an opponent; they now disappear based on their level, so timing will be more important.

Fixed some rare bugs related to the customer system.





{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/8b03f673c87fe7fac4712c42abc5955e4eab63b5.png-SIERRA

notes.title: BUNDLE TABLE
notes.content:
Hello dear players!
We’ve finally addressed an issue that the community has been talking about for a long time: extra cars in your collection!
Now you can easily solve this with the new Bundle Table – purchase it, bundle your extra cars, and sell them!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/0fbed44fcaf185b0abb30ca751eef3a3c36a9c0d.gif

Update Notes:

Bundle Table has been added to the game. You can now package and sell extra cars from your collection.

Fixed the issue where customers were not evenly distributed across cash registers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/1d3de494e308daf2916eae6fa8a947710d5ffa6b.png

Economy balance adjustments.

Fixed several issues related to the car collection.

Fixed bugs during product scanning at the checkout.

Launch-exclusive cars will no longer appear in the Faster series and can now be found under the "Souvenirs" section in your collection. These cars can now only be obtained through NPC races.

In races, only one of each skill card can now be selected.

Added 3 new sellable products.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/d7a8cee0e26cfdc18a0d470f993db780f3ef488e.png

Cars affected by skills can no longer use other skills.

Time-rewind skill power has been reduced.

Drop rate of Tier 3 skill cards has been lowered.

The bug of every car display a speed of 100 has been fixed

Fixed an issue where particle effects would get stuck at the end of races.

Fixed text overflow issues in the end-of-day report.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/17ec5a571f2af23d7901b7d16d2088143e08666a.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/ab98e996c6553c42f0d17ac9ece6dc185b9e067a.png




{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/8b03f673c87fe7fac4712c42abc5955e4eab63b5.png -SIERRA

notes.title: Collectors #1 - Car Love from a Collector
notes.content:
Greetings, collectors! 

You know why you're here, right? There's only one reason: you want to build your dream supercar collection and take it to the top. I've seen my fair share of obstacles over the years as an old collector, but each one taught me what true collecting is all about…

In these posts, I'll share with you how to do more than just collect cars. You'll learn how to make them valuable, uncover their histories, and build your collection with the right strategies.
But remember, no matter how much theory you learn, nothing beats the hands-on experience. 

Download Supercar Collection Simulator Demo, get behind the wheel, and then come back here. Let’s hit the road together! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453690/Supercar_Collection_Simulator_Demo/

Is everyone ready? Let’s get started… Oh, and don’t forget to wishlist Supercar Collection Simulator right now, so you’ll be all set to build your ultimate garage and take on the world of racing and collecting as soon as it’s out! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3453600/Supercar_Collection_Simulator/

Let’s look our key points:

Displaying Your Collection
What’s the most important part of any toy car collection? Yes! THE CARS, of course! If you want to impress other collectors, you need to display your collection properly. You can’t just toss them in a drawer and expect people to appreciate them. It’s not a cluttered shelf; it’s a carefully curated exhibit. Use display cases, stands, and custom shelves to show off your most prized pieces. The better you display them, the more attention they’ll get!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/09b0f6f1ef68eaea57f5cd6e5a27150afdeb298f.gif

Building Your Reputation
You can own all the supercars in the world, but if no one knows about your collection, what’s the point? Building a solid reputation is crucial. Organise races, show off your best cars, and let other collectors be in network. Your name will be on the tip of everyone's tongue, and soon enough.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/229d8110aadc27de19c563a6bdbda19188e64a38.gif

The Thrill of the Mystery Box
There’s nothing quite like the excitement of cracking open a new card pack. You never know what you’re going to get, will it be that rare, limited-edition car you’ve been eyeing, or will it be another duplicate? That’s the magic of it all. Each pack is a mystery waiting to be unraveled, and every pull could bring a new addition to your collection. You’ve got to take the gamble. After all, the best pieces don’t just appear; they’re uncovered in these mystery boxes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/65250f66261d24bd3cd20a973a6e616fb6a00e25.gif

That about wraps up today’s lesson!

Catch you in the next post, where we’ll dive even deeper into the world of toy car collecting!
If you want to connect with other passionate collectors, why not join our Discord server? You can chat about cars, collections, and all things toy cars with fellow car lovers.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471469/58bd0d5ff8eb0ccd34e2c2479845ceedb159c8e8.png
